item.title: spectra-cobra
item.description:
SPECTRA reconstructs metabolic networks from multi-omics data at a range of biological scales: minimal reactomes, context-specific models, gap-filled reconstructions, minimal microbiomes, microbial community models and multi-tissue models. What changes between them is the universal model, the evidence supplied and the objective chosen, not the routine called.

Two options give that range. consistency_type picks the steady state S v = 0 or the accumulation condition S v >= 0 that gap filling needs. problem_type picks the objective: minimise total flux, minimise reaction count, maximise signed omics evidence, or maximise biomass against a flux penalty.
